Quick Answers What role does Arona play in Blue Archive? In Blue Archive, Arona is a non-playable AI assistant who guides the player, known as Sensei, in their Kivotos adventure. As the main mascot of Blue Archive, Arona is featured on the game's website and social media. She resides in the Shittim Chest and provides updates and support to Sensei. She also runs the Arona Channel video series Provided by: Community What is the purpose of the Arona Channel? The "Arona Channel", created by Arona, served as a platform for her to interact with Sensei with various antics along the way. The series, featuring Arona as the host, released short videos biweekly from April 7, 2021, to July 23, 2023 in the official Blue Archive Japanese Channel. It was later succeeded by the "AroPla Channel". Provided by: Community How does Arona interact with Sensei in Blue Archive? Arona is a guide for Sensei during their Kivotos adventure. She offers information, assistance, and safeguards Sensei via the Shittim Chest. Arona also operates the Arona Channel, a video series featuring her interactions with Sensei. She has the capacity to divert resources for combat calculations to ensure Sensei's safety and can even shield Sensei from significant threats like gunfire and even cruise missiles. Provided by: Community Why is Arona considered the mascot of Blue Archive? Arona appears in the game's app icon and greets the player upon logging into the game. During her reign, all Arius students were forced to play by her rules, and those who dare retaliate would be greatly punished. Provided by: Community Why does Beatrice view Sensei as an antagonist? Beatrice perceives Sensei as an adversary due to her obsession with power and control, contrasting Sensei's ideals that a student must be free. Her antagonistic view of Sensei is intensified by her determination to eliminate any obstacles, including Sensei, and her resentment towards Sensei's disapproval of her actions. This sets her apart from other Gematria members who see Sensei as either a rival or an ally. Provided by: Community What is Beatrice's relationship with the other members of Gematria? Beatrice's relationship with Gematria is strained due to her disregard for the artistic integrity of their work, focusing instead on power gain. Her arrival sparked disputes and her use of Maestro's creations as weapons deepened the rift. She sees Sensei, a figure respected by other members, as an enemy. Her actions during Volume F led to Gematria's temporary disbandment and her expulsion. This cybernetic entity, first spotted in Abydos, is known for its heavy armor and powerful abilities. Labeled as "The Observant Understander Who Acutely Perceives Difference" by the Super Phenomenon Task Force, it roams and wreaks havoc around the vast desert of Abydos. Provided by: Community What features separate Binah from the other prophets of Decagrammaton? Binah takes the form of a colossal snake, possessing the ability to travel within the earth. Underground, it's nigh impossible to detect, allowing it to easily ambush its targets. It's usually found in the desert of Abydos, likely due to the advantageous environment provided by the desertification. Quick Answers What led to Hod's transformation into the eighth prophet of the Decagrammaton? In Blue Archive, Hod was initially a high-performance computational engine called 'Hub', serving as a communications AI in Millennium. Originally the Millennium's communications unit AI, Hod was hacked by an unknown AI, leading him to proclaim himself as Decagrammaton's eighth prophet. To participate in the Hod raid, players must first complete Mission 4 Act 1. The raid has a 04:00 time limit and Hod is characterized by his heavy armor defense. She shows little interest in both others and herself, and her wrist and neck are layered thickly with bandages, as if attempting to hide something...

Compared to the other Arius Squad members, Misaki's actions resemble the Squad's beliefs the most. Although the Squad believes that everything is in vain, their actions seem to contradict that. Misaki, however, suffers from severe depression between her frail body and the abuse she suffered during her time in Arius. Because of this, she has repeatedly cut herself and outright attempted suicide on multiple occasions, only being stopped by Saori and later Sensei. Her depression has eased by the time of Sheside Outside, though she remains distant and reserved.

Chihiro is serious, pragmatic and one of the most skilled hackers among Veritas, being its deputy director, but is also the most restrained among them. Where the rest of the group easily delves into spying, hacking and cracking for their own ends, Chihiro generally tries to make sure they don't go overboard.

She is often called on as a security consultant to help strengthen safety measures throughout Kivotos, whether the means be physical or digital. Despite the workload, she is secretly proud of being relied on, comparing herself to a coffee machine that still sells coffee through the night. That being said, she will get annoyed if the people she's helping make her job harder for her by being lax or reckless with their security.
